column1: # sfz2al ARRANGE trigger map -- arcade sound command -> Saturn MUS song.
# Capcom's own dispatch table: the Anthology zero6
# comp2 type-1 rows at +0x17fa0 (US; regionally byte-identical), entry
# rebased by adx_entry = 169 + saturn_song (the all-60-songs identity proven
# in sfz2_saturn_zero6_map.tsv, which remains the evidence file and is
# cross-checked against this map at build time).  Type-1 rows pointing at
# ADX entry 0 (1 s of silence -- the PS2 "any other music-range command
# stops the BGM" idiom) are the stop rows.  This map is used directly, with
# no runtime dependency on the extraction/ blob.
# comp2_vol is Capcom's per-row volume byte, recorded for provenance only:
# trigger gain is the measured EBU R128 loudness match (TRIG_GAIN in
# build_saturn.py), which overrides it for sfa2/sfz2al.
